user.title: Set up Scheduler
user.description: This will create the Scheduler hub. You can add schedules after setup by clicking the Configure button.

abort.already_configured: Scheduler is already configured. Use the configure button to manage schedules.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Scheduler instance is allowed

add_schedule.title: Add New Schedule
add_schedule.description: Enter a name for your schedule and choose the schedule type

data_description.name: Enter a name for this schedule
data_description.schedule_type: Choose to schedule by date or by week of the month

rename_schedule.title: Rename Schedule
rename_schedule.description: Select a schedule to rename or enter a new name

data_description.name: Enter the new name for this schedule

date_config.title: Configure Date-Based Schedule
date_config.description: Set the month and day range for your schedule

data_description.start_day: Day of the month when the schedule starts (1-31)
data_description.end_day: Day of the month when the schedule ends (1-31)
data_description.additional_yaml: Optional YAML configuration for advanced settings. Leave empty if not needed.

week_config.title: Configure Week-Based Schedule
week_config.description: Set the month, week, and day of week range for your schedule

data_description.start_week: Week number when the schedule starts (0-4, where 0 is the first week)
data_description.start_day_of_week: Day of the week when the schedule starts
data_description.end_week: Week number when the schedule ends (0-4, where 4 is the last week)
data_description.end_day_of_week: Day of the week when the schedule ends
data_description.additional_yaml: Optional YAML configuration for advanced settings. Leave empty if not needed.

nth_day_config.title: Configure Nth-Day Schedule
nth_day_config.description: Set a date range around a specific occurrence of a weekday in a month

data_description.occurrence: Which occurrence of the day (first, second, third, fourth, or last)
data_description.start_offset: How many days before the target date should the schedule be active (0-30)
data_description.end_offset: How many days after the target date should the schedule be active (0-30)
data_description.additional_yaml: Optional YAML configuration for advanced settings. Leave empty if not needed.

error.invalid_month_range: Start month must be before or equal to end month
error.invalid_day_of_week: Day of week must be between 0 and 6
error.invalid_yaml: Invalid YAML format in additional configuration
error.schedule_overlap: This schedule overlaps with an existing schedule
